title: Kline snapshot 与 microstructure 高频数据不应默认混成一个物理宽表

metadata.classification_notes: 本条主归属 Trading Engineering / Market Microstructure，因为它约束 tick、order book、trade prints、spread、depth、OFI、CVD 等 microstructure 数据与 K 线 snapshot 的本体边界；AI/Database Engineering 只消费其存储与 manifest 关系。

applies_when: 外接项目同时使用 K 线 snapshot、技术指标、盘口、成交打印或订单流特征
AI IDE 设计交易训练数据、feature store、microstructure store 或 dataset snapshot manifest
需要区分低频决策上下文和高频市场事件存储

用户要求具体数据库 DDL、物理部署方案或性能调优参数

content.statement: Kline snapshot、指标和 entry/exit snap 属于低频决策上下文；tick、order book、trade prints、spread、depth、OFI、CVD 等 microstructure 原始或高频聚合数据属于高写入、高粒度市场事件层。二者不应默认混入一个物理宽表；除非有明确的规模、写入频率、保留策略、查询模式、审计需求和成本评估证明宽表可控，否则应按数据粒度、写入频率、查询模式、保留策略和审计需求物理分层，再通过可追溯引用和 point-in-time manifest 组合到训练样本。
content.rationale: 本条不是数据库选型建议，不强制 ClickHouse、kdb+、Feast、Iceberg 或任何单一技术；它只约束 K 线低频 snapshot 与 microstructure 高频事件的边界。

assumptions: 外接项目必须定义自己的 venue、instrument、calendar、timestamp、data vendor 和 quality report。
microstructure 原始数据进入训练前必须先形成 decision-time feature，并通过 available_time / known_at 检查。
本候选通过严格审计前不得进入正式 reviewed 知识库。

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Feast documents point-in-time correct feature sets for training data and leakage prevention.
ClickHouse documents MergeTree family for large data volumes and high ingestion workloads, supporting high-frequency event store as an implementation pattern.
KX documents tick architecture patterns for real-time and historical market data capture, processing and analysis.
Iceberg supports hidden partitioning and partition evolution, illustrating that logical datasets should not be locked to one physical layout.
Binance documents separate futures market data websocket streams, supporting venue-specific market data stream modeling rather than one universal wide table.
Databento documents market data schemas and formats, supporting vendor-specific event schema mapping for market data stores.
CoinAPI market data documentation supports using vendor-specific market data contracts for candles, trades, order books, or related market data resources.

limitations: 外部来源主要支撑工程模式；交易领域字段本体仍需 CEK-TA Market Microstructure 和 Data Engineering 契约承接。

source_quality_notes: Reviewed/caveat_only: sources support architecture and contract boundaries, not database mandates, trading advice, or model-performance claims.
Official technology and vendor documents are implementation-pattern evidence and must not be treated as mandatory CEK-TA dependencies.
